gizmo.title: Kudzidzira masvomhu
gizmo.description: Mibvunzo mipfupi yemasvomhu inogadzirwa ine mhinduro ipapo ipapo. Sarudza maitirwo nehuwandu hwenhamba; kuita kwese kutsva.

configure.title: Musoro
configure.description: Zita rekudzidzira uku, rinoratidzwa pamusoro pako.

configure.title: Maitirwo
configure.description: Mhando dzemibvunzo dzinobvunzwa. Vadzidzi vanogona kudzima chero chimwe chazvo vasati vatanga.

configure.title: Nhamba diki
configure.description: Nhamba diki inoshandiswa mumubvunzo. Nhamba dzakazara, 0 kana kupfuura.

configure.title: Nhamba huru
configure.description: Nhamba huru inoshandiswa mumubvunzo. Mhinduro dzekugovanisa nevagovanisi zvinoramba zviri muhuwandu uhu.

configure.title: Huwandu hwemibvunzo
configure.description: Mibvunzo mingani iri mukuita kumwe (1 kusvika 100).

advanced.title: Muganhu wenguva
advanced.description: Masekondi anobvumidzwa pakuita kwese. 0 zvinoreva kuti hapana nguva, ndizvo zvakajairwa: kudzidzira kune nguva kunokundisa vadzidzi vanoda nguva yakawanda. Kana yaiswa, vadzidzi vanogona kuzvidzimira nguva.

advanced.title: Ruvara rwekusimbisa
advanced.description: Ruvara rwechip yemusoro nemabhatani. Siya pasina chinhu kuti utevere theme.
